title: Mike Tyson earned $400 million and went broke
description:
Two tigers, a trainer on a salary, and a tax bill. How a fortune that big disappears — and the money rule underneath it.

New video every day.

scenes.say: Mike Tyson earned close to four hundred million dollars in the ring. In two thousand three, he filed for bankruptcy.
He kept two white Bengal tigers. Reported at a hundred and forty thousand dollars.
Their trainer was a hundred and twenty five thousand a year. A salary, for the tigers.
But the tigers are not the lesson. Every win bought a bigger life, and a bigger life sends its bill every single month.
When the fights slowed down, the bills did not. He owed the tax office more than thirteen million.
Income is a number that can stop. Lifestyle is a number that keeps going.
Most people do not go broke because they earn too little. They go broke in the gap between those two numbers.
